item.title: Your AI Conversations Are Not Privileged: What a New SDNY Ruling Means for Every Lawyer and Client

item.title: Federal Court Challenges USCIS’s EB-1A Final Merits Denial: What It Means for Extraordinary Ability Petitioners
item.description: When an EB-1A Denial Raises Legal Red Flags A federal district court in Nebraska recently overturned the denial of an extraordinary ability petition in Mukherji v. Miller, finding that the agency’s “final merits” determination was unlawful. item.title: L-1 Visa for Canadian Citizens: Transferring from Canada to the U.S. (2026)
item.description: Canadian professionals working for international companies can transfer to U.S. offices through the L-1 intracompany transferee visa.
